web.description:
# Pay, entitlements and working conditions
## Getting paid
### Penalty rates and allowances
In many jobs, employees get penalty rates for evening, weekend, public holiday and overtime work.

#### **![](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/sites/default/files/2022-08/yw-example-icon.png)Example: Penalty rates**
Tunde is rostered to work 2 weeknights, from 8pm until midnight, and all-day Saturday. Tunde’s employer tells her that she’ll get paid $25 per hour.

Under the award, she is entitled to penalty rates for working on a Saturday and for working between 10pm and midnight.

web.title: Penalty Rates in Australia: Weekend, Public Holiday & Overtime Pay
web.description: Yes, casual employees are absolutely entitled to penalty rates. These penalties are applied on top of their casual loading (usually 25%).

web.title: Casual shiftworkers and penalty rates in the Retail Award [K600196]
web.description: Public holiday work. Casual shiftworkers get paid 250% of their minimum hourly rate for all work on a public holiday. This rate includes their casual loading.
